summary: Arrange furniture in a measured authored room with visible footprint and door-sweep checks.
objective: Create a studio layout where I can move the bed, desk and chair and see door-swing conflicts.
example_prompts: Create a studio layout where I can move the bed, desk and chair and see door-swing conflicts.
Save two furniture arrangements and compare their walking space.

entities.name: Room
entities.guidance: Walls with thickness, one hinged doorway and window reveals; provide a floor grid in meters.

entities.name: Furniture
entities.guidance: Bed frame and mattress, desk legs/top and chair seat/back with distinct footprints.

object_craft.structure: Walls with thickness, one hinged doorway and window reveals; provide a floor grid in meters.
object_craft.material: Matte painted walls, wood-looking floor and clear glass.

object_craft.structure: Bed frame and mattress, desk legs/top and chair seat/back with distinct footprints.
object_craft.material: Textile bedding, timber desk and upholstered seat.
object_craft.articulation: Door rotates about a jamb pivot; furniture rotates about its footprint anchor.

state_contract.model: Authored room and furniture footprints, rigid poses, door angle and saved layouts; clearance margins are editable assumptions.
state_contract.authority: Domain state owns identities, values and accepted transitions. Derive labels and meshes from that state; camera and display offsets are separate.
actions: Open door and display sweep envelope.

invariants: Footprints cannot cross solid walls in accepted layouts.
Conflict state includes door sweep and furniture, not only center-point tests.
motion_guidance: Use plan-view dragging with snap feedback; keep orbit gestures separate.
Show invalid tentative placement without committing it.
known_limits: Clearance is a geometric design aid, not accessibility or building-code certification.
Floor plan must come from user dimensions or be labeled invented.
Authored recipe only; runtime and rendered geometry checks have not run.
creative_affordances: Restrained materials make furniture proportions and free floor areas easier to compare.

colliders: 2D footprints, wall polygons and door sweep.
driving: Pointer translation and rotation with declared grid.
contact: Geometric overlap rejection, not furniture contact dynamics.
physical_contract.timestep: Use a declared fixed update step for changing model state; interpolate presentation only. Pause clears accumulated playback time.
checks: Reject desk across door sweep; reset restores stored poses.
